en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ja`far al-Himyari narrated to us from Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from Ibrahim b. Muhzim from Talha b. Zayd from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father (as).  He said:
Pray over anyone who dies from the people of the qibla. His judgment is with Allah.
